== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Dark Waters & •Krayt Dragon Bones (Errata 3)]] (<code>2261_3033</code>, Virtual Block 6.1 slip 32), showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The text box was placed by hand: CardMaker set this long text above the banner, so the text layer of a render was moved down into the text box of a render without text (same renderer, same fonts).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201), post p719737 by Aglets, 9 May 2012: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p719737
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “Deploy on Rancor Pit or Execution Arena. During your battle phase, if on Rancor Pit and you have no presence here, may relocate a captive from Audience Chamber to here. If opponent's character here was just eaten, retrieve 3 Force. If a creature here is lost, owner loses Force equal to half its printed deploy cost (round up). Once per turn, if a creature here is about to draw destiny for ferocity, may instead use its destiny number. May ▼ a non-[Selective] ferocious creature here. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-32-Dark_Waters_Krayt_Dragon_Bones-PC-E3-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
